evidence.observation: Heater H701 temperature climbs steadily 374→381.5 °C, far above all other temperatures, while reboiler T703 stays flat at ~65.7 °C — heat not transferring / possible dry or low-level reboiler heater
Reboiler temperature essentially static (65.5→65.8 °C) over 20 min despite heating
Distillate flow near zero and erratic (0.01–0.16), no product take-off
Column pressure drop very low (~0.05–0.28 mbar), indicating little vapour traffic
Top-section temperatures flat at ~58.2 °C, no separation profile development

args.missing_evidence: Reboiler liquid level/charge confirmation and heater power setpoint; a composition sample of distillate/bottoms; verification that T701 is reading a real surface temperature rather than a detached/drifting thermocouple
